tools.name: betteroff_get_overview
tools.title: Get overview
tools.summary: Household valuation, data coverage, identity, and connection health.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a household financial overview or data coverage. Get a compact household picture: latest stored valuation, account coverage, canonical ledger review counts, and the masked login and household name. No provider refresh.

tools.name: betteroff_get_setup_status
tools.title: Get setup status
tools.summary: Remaining setup steps, billing status, and reconnect links.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is left to set up, wants to connect a bank or add a manual item, whether billing is active, or which connections need reconnecting. Cheap status check: whether this connection works, which permissions it has, and whether any accounts are connected. Returns billing state, account coverage, connections to reconnect, and sign-in-protected links for the user to connect a bank or add a manual item. Access issues link to support, not checkout. This tool cannot start checkout, connect accounts, or change agent access.

tools.name: betteroff_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.summary: Accounts with balances and balance observation dates.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which accounts are connected or wants account balances. Get the user's connected accounts with balances, types, and institutions.

tools.name: betteroff_get_net_worth_history
tools.title: Get net worth history
tools.summary: Stored net-worth valuations over a period.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how net worth changed over time. Read stored household valuations over time, paged by cursor. For a two-date explanation use betteroff_explain_net_worth_change.

tools.name: betteroff_explain_net_worth_change
tools.title: Explain net worth change
tools.summary: Reconciles the change between two stored valuations.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what caused net worth to change between two dates. Reconcile two stored net-worth valuations using asset and liability changes.

tools.name: betteroff_search_transactions
tools.title: Search transactions
tools.summary: Finds transactions and totals a filtered set, including merchant history.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to find transactions or total a filtered set of transactions. Search transactions by date, merchant, category, trait, type/class, account, or amount; a summary totals all matches. Brokerage deposits/withdrawals: transactionClass `brokerage`, transactionTypes `transfer_in`/`transfer_out`/`deposit`/`withdrawal`.

tools.name: betteroff_analyze_spending
tools.title: Analyze spending
tools.summary: Spending by category or merchant, with an optional period comparison.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where money went or compares spending across periods. Read category or merchant spending for a period, optionally against an earlier one. Excludes transfers and loan payments; fees and interest count.

tools.name: betteroff_detect_spending_patterns
tools.title: Detect spending patterns
tools.summary: Spending habits, trends, and unusual transactions.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about spending habits, trends, or unusual transactions. Detect spending patterns: frequent merchants, complete-month trends, and unusual transactions (monthly repeats such as rent excluded). Frequent merchants are habits, not bills; use betteroff_list_recurring for recurring charges.

tools.name: betteroff_get_account_flows
tools.title: Get account flows
tools.summary: Gross deposits and withdrawals for specific accounts.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much entered or left specific accounts. Gross inflows, gross outflows, and net flow for selected accounts over a date range, aggregated over ALL matches server-side, e.g. 'how much did I deposit into Schwab this year'. Prefer this over betteroff_search_transactions for deposit/withdrawal totals.

tools.name: betteroff_get_cash_flow
tools.title: Get cash flow
tools.summary: Household income, expenses, and savings rate.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about income, expenses, or cash flow. Get income vs expenses for a period with prior-period comparison and projections. Use for cash flow, earned vs spent, or saving questions.

tools.name: betteroff_preview_cash_plan
tools.title: Preview cash plan
tools.summary: Read-only cash-plan scenario from amounts the user confirmed. Moves no money.
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a cash-plan scenario after confirming the available cash, upcoming obligations, spending allowance and buffer. Calculate a read-only USD cash-plan scenario from inputs the customer explicitly confirmed. Never invent a balance, buffer, spending allowance, bill or confirmation. Does not reserve or move money.

tools.name: betteroff_get_cash_rules
tools.title: Get cash rules
tools.summary: The household's order for idle cash, amount kept back, and bank, brokerage and onchain split.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what order they set for idle cash, what amount they keep back, or what split they set across bank, brokerage and onchain. Read the household's own plan: the order it chose for idle cash across debt, bills, savings goals and earn, the amount it keeps back, and its split across Bank, Brokerage and Onchain.

tools.name: betteroff_list_recurring
tools.title: List recurring
tools.summary: Observed recurring bills, subscriptions, and income.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about recurring bills, subscriptions, or income. Get Plaid-reported recurring streams (active, early, inactive), without credit card payments. Not a payment history (use search_transactions) or proof of insurance coverage.

tools.name: betteroff_get_portfolio
tools.title: Get portfolio
tools.summary: Investment positions, allocation, and concentration.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about investment holdings, allocation, or concentration. Read portfolio positions, allocation, and concentration for the full filtered portfolio. includePositions false returns the allocation summary; true pages positions by cursor.

tools.name: betteroff_get_defi_positions
tools.title: Get defi positions
tools.summary: DeFi lending, staking, and liquidity positions with assets and liabilities.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about DeFi, lending, staking, or LP positions, or protocol exposure. DeFi exposure by protocol across chains: total value, position count, per-asset breakdown.

tools.name: betteroff_get_vault_yields
tools.title: Get vault yields
tools.summary: Reported APY of vaults available in Investing; not recommendations.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for current APYs of the vaults Investing lists. Reported APYs for vaults Investing offers: Morpho USDC and USDT on Ethereum, USDC on Base, and pathUSD on Tempo, plus Ethena vaults while Investing offers them. Each row has the protocol's source and date. Filter by venue or asset symbol. 50 per page by name; pass nextCursor as cursor.

tools.name: betteroff_list_debts
tools.title: List debts
tools.summary: Debt balances, terms, and missing terms.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what they owe or which debt terms are missing. Get the user's debts (cards and loans): names with last digits, balances with balanceAsOf, APRs, minimum payments, totals, and a balance-weighted average APR. Use for debt, interest rate, or payoff-priority questions.

tools.name: betteroff_simulate_debt_payoff
tools.title: Simulate debt payoff
tools.summary: Arithmetic payoff scenarios; refuses when terms are missing.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to compare debt payoff strategies. Simulate paying off debts by avalanche (highest APR first) or snowball (smallest balance first), with an optional extra monthly payment. Debts missing a balance, APR, minimum payment, or FX rate are listed in skippedDebts. betteroff_propose_debt_details saves terms the user states. Read-only; never moves money.

tools.name: betteroff_get_checklist
tools.title: Get checklist
tools.summary: Financial checklist progress, such as insurance, estate documents, and emergency fund.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what to do next, how prepared the household is, or about insurance, estate documents, an emergency fund, retirement accounts, or credit freezes; for an explicit saved tax-review request, use includeTaxReviews to read current scoped results. Get the household's readiness checklist: 0-100 score, 30-day change, and each item's status, evidence, and points. Edits happen in BetterOff. taxReviewsStatus says if Taxes is enabled.

tools.name: betteroff_list_deadlines
tools.title: List deadlines
tools.summary: Recorded household deadlines, insurance renewals, and federal tax dates.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is due soon: tax dates, renewals, RMDs, filings, estate tasks, or other dated deadlines. List the household's recorded deadlines, insurance renewals and federal tax dates.

tools.name: betteroff_list_insurance
tools.title: List insurance
tools.summary: Insurance policies the household recorded, with coverage, premium, and renewal date.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which insurance policies are on record, their coverage amounts, premiums, or renewal dates. List the insurance policies the household recorded, with coverage, premium and renewal date.

tools.name: betteroff_get_budgets
tools.title: Get budgets
tools.summary: Category budgets against this month's spending, and savings goal progress.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how spending compares with their category budgets or how their savings goals are progressing. Read the household's category budgets against this month's spending, and savings goals against their linked accounts.

tools.name: betteroff_estimate_quarterly_tax
tools.title: Estimate quarterly tax
tools.summary: US federal safe-harbor estimated tax from figures the user states.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much federal estimated tax to pay each quarter or about safe harbor. Compute US federal quarterly estimated tax by safe harbor from figures the user states. Ask for missing figures; never guess.

tools.name: betteroff_get_giving_and_fees
tools.title: Get giving and fees
tools.summary: Yearly charitable giving, personal gifts, bank fees, and investment fees.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much they gave to charity in a year, or what they paid in bank or investment fees. Get yearly totals of charitable donations, personal gifts, bank fees and investment fees from transactions, with fees per account.

tools.name: betteroff_search_activity
tools.title: Search activity
tools.summary: Recorded financial record changes and correction proposals.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about recorded account changes or correction proposals. Read permitted record changes. For an account's correction proposals (pending or approved), set accountId (via betteroff_list_accounts), actorType=all, action=null; needs corrections:prepare. Omits security events and raw fields.

tools.name: betteroff_list_observations
tools.title: List observations
tools.summary: Stored financial findings and their status.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about recorded financial findings and their status. Read recorded household financial findings and their status. Excludes insurance checklist findings. Does not refresh or dismiss findings.

tools.name: betteroff_propose_category_change
tools.title: Propose category change
tools.summary: Saves a pending category correction for approval in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to correct the category of selected transactions. Prepare a durable category correction for selected transaction IDs. This saves a pending proposal and changes no financial records. The user must open the authenticated review link and explicitly choose selected payments or matching and future payments. Never report a proposal as applied.

tools.name: betteroff_propose_recurring_kind
tools.title: Propose recurring kind
tools.summary: Saves a pending bill-or-subscription classification for approval in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user says a recurring payment should be a bill or a subscription, for example that a Zelle payment is rent. Propose marking one of the user's recurring outgoing payments as a bill or a subscription. Get the streamId first with betteroff_list_recurring. This tool changes nothing: the user opens the review link and approves it in BetterOff. Never say the change is done.

tools.name: betteroff_propose_debt_details
tools.title: Propose debt details
tools.summary: Saves user-stated debt terms for approval in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user provides a debt's APR, minimum payment, or next due date to save. Propose saving debt details the user states in chat: APR, minimum payment, or next due date, e.g. 'my Chase card APR is 24.99%'. Pass debtId from betteroff_list_debts, else the debt name. Use only numbers the user stated. This changes nothing until the user approves it at the review link; never say it is done.

tools.name: betteroff_propose_allocation_targets
tools.title: Propose allocation targets
tools.summary: Saves user-stated target allocation for approval in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user states their own target allocation percentages or drift thresholds to save. Propose the target allocation the user stated (groups from betteroff_get_portfolio, percents, thresholds); never suggest one. Nothing changes until the user approves it.

tools.name: betteroff_propose_budget
tools.title: Propose budget
tools.summary: Saves a user-stated category budget for approval in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user states a monthly amount to budget for a spending category. Propose a monthly category budget with an amount the user stated; never suggest one. Nothing changes until the user approves it at the review link.

tools.name: betteroff_request_transfer
tools.title: Request transfer
tools.summary: Requests a USDC transfer between the household's own wallets; the user signs in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to move USDC between two of their own tracked wallets on Solana. Request a USDC transfer on Solana between two wallets this household tracks. Saves a request for the user to review; never approves, signs, or sends. Return the review link and say it awaits the user's approval and wallet signature.

tools.name: betteroff_request_bank_transfer
tools.title: Request bank transfer
tools.summary: Requests a transfer between the user's own linked accounts; the user confirms with a passkey.

tools.name: betteroff_request_vault_deposit
tools.title: Request vault deposit
tools.summary: Requests a USDC or USDT vault deposit; the user signs in BetterOff.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to deposit USDC, USDT, or pathUSD from one of their own wallets into a vault they chose from Investing. Deposits go from a tracked EVM wallet into a Morpho vault on Ethereum, Base, or Tempo listed by betteroff_get_vault_yields. Saves a request for the user to review; never approves, signs, or deposits. Only prepare a deposit into a vault the user named; never pick one. Return the review link and say it awaits the user's approval and wallet signature.

tools.name: betteroff_get_action_request
tools.title: Get action request
tools.summary: Status of a transfer or deposit request.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a requested transfer was approved, sent, or confirmed. Read a USDC transfer, bank transfer, or vault deposit request's status from BetterOff's records.

tools.name: betteroff_get_money_activity
tools.title: Get money activity
tools.summary: Natural wallet balances and the status of payments, requests, and transfers.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about Natural wallet balances or the status of a payment, bill, request or transfer. Read the current user's Natural wallets, payments, requests, transfers, bills or payees with outcome explanations. Read-only; never sends, approves or cancels money.

tools.name: betteroff_cancel_action_request
tools.title: Cancel action request
tools.summary: Cancels a pending request before it is signed.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to cancel a transfer request before signing it. Cancel a USDC transfer, bank transfer, or vault deposit request before the user signs or approves it.

tools.name: betteroff_track_wallet
tools.title: Track a wallet
tools.summary: Adds a public wallet address the user provides.
tools.description: Add a public wallet address the user gave you so BetterOff tracks its balances. Read-only: it cannot sign or move funds. Only use an address the user provided. Never send a recovery phrase or private key. The import runs in the background, so check accounts again after about a minute.

tools.name: betteroff_submit_feedback
tools.title: Submit feedback
tools.summary: Sends a user-approved diagnostic report to BetterOff support.
tools.description: Send a diagnostic report to BetterOff support only when the user requests or approves sending it. Creates a support case, not a financial correction. Never send conversation history, balances, transactions, tool payloads, or credentials. Reuse the idempotency key when retrying. Returns a receipt, not a promise of resolution.

tools.name: betteroff_get_checkout_link
tools.title: Get checkout link
tools.summary: Sign-in-protected link to start a BetterOff plan checkout.
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to buy more AI, upgrade to Better, or pay for BetterOff. Returns a link for the user to buy something themselves in secure Stripe Checkout. This tool cannot charge anyone. "ai" is more AI: a one-time $5 Chat Boost on a paid plan, or the Better plan on Free. Share the link and let the user decide.
